How It Began

The Origin

Cupid created a society for those who lacked confidence but were meant to embody it — with the belief that clothing could do more than dress the body. It could shift how a person carries themselves in the world. Built to awaken confidence and presence in every individual.

it’s a community.

Membership

Membership Requirements

Because loyalty deserves to be celebrated.

To become an official Cupids Society Member, applicants must:

  • ♡Maintain a fashion/lifestyle-aligned aesthetic
  • ♡Be willing to create and post Cupids Society content
  • ♡Tag @CupidsSocietyBoutique when featuring the brand
  • ♡Share their unique Cupid Ambassador Code
  • ♡Post a minimum of 2 Cupids Society-related pieces of content per month
  • ♡Support and engage with Society launches, events & campaigns
  • ♡Represent the brand in a classy, respectful and authentic manner
  • ♡Be willing to attend selected Cupids Society events/pop-ups where possible
  • ♡No minimum follower count required — engagement, personality and brand fit matter more

Membership Perks

  • ♡Member-only discounts & flash sales
  • ♡Early access to new drops & limited pieces
  • ♡Free shipping on orders $500+
  • ♡Exclusive birthday rewards
  • ♡First access to one-of-one pieces
  • ♡Members-only events & experiences
  • ♡Member spotlights & creator opportunities
  • ♡Vote on future collections, colours & events
  • ♡Exclusive giveaways & gifts
  • ♡Referral rewards for bringing friends into the Society
  • ♡First access to pop-ups & special experiences
  • ♡Style advice & community outfit sharing

Policies

Shipping & Returns

Shipping

We ship locally across Trinidad & Tobago (3–5 business days) and internationally (7–14 business days). Orders are processed within 1–2 business days. Free local delivery on orders over TTD $1,500.

Returns

We accept returns within 7 days of delivery. Items must be in original, unworn condition with all tags attached. Swimwear is final sale. To initiate a return, contact us via WhatsApp.

Exchanges

We’re happy to exchange for a different size if available. Contact us within 7 days of delivery. The customer is responsible for return shipping costs.

Damaged Items

If your piece arrives damaged, contact us immediately on WhatsApp with a photo. We will replace or refund damaged items at no cost to you.
